metadata.description: Governed mined-factor registry. Quant branch only consumes production_factor entries with all 8 gates passed.
metadata.default_policy: No mined factor is live until manually promoted to production_factor.
metadata.known_limitation: Offline neutralization uses hs300/zz500/zz1000 universe buckets because complete industry map was unavailable in the local snapshot.

factors.name: pv_volume_stability_15d
factors.description: Negative 15-day coefficient of variation of volume; stable participation scores higher.

gate_results.title: Gate 1: 数据安全
reasons: 已确认 point-in-time、availability_date、复权与可交易性口径。

gate_results.title: Gate 2: 覆盖率和稳定性
reasons: 覆盖率、缺失率、行业与市值分布通过。

gate_results.title: Gate 3: IC / RankIC
reasons: IC/RankIC 达到观察门槛，且方向未显示单一年份依赖。

gate_results.title: Gate 4: 分组收益
reasons: 分组收益、top quantile 与 long-short spread 通过。

gate_results.title: Gate 5: 交易成本和换手
reasons: 交易成本、滑点、换手与容量通过。

gate_results.title: Gate 6: 中性化和暴露分析
reasons: 中性化后仍有 alpha，且与现有因子不过度重合。

gate_results.title: Gate 7: 样本外和稳健性
reasons: walk-forward、参数、日期、频率、universe 与市场阶段稳健性通过。

gate_results.title: Gate 8: 组合增量验证
reasons: baseline + new factor 相对 baseline 有组合级增量。

metadata.recovery_reason: registry was empty although 2026-05-29 promoted mining report and health reports show 12 production_factor entries
metadata.validation_note: Neutralization uses hs300/zz500/zz1000 universe buckets as a local size/liquidity proxy because no complete industry map is available in the offline data snapshot.
